description: UI pass 2: Library destination. Depends on FEAT-001 (selectors/reducers/getRecordSvg/redactWifi), FEAT-002 (Menu, Dialog, ConfirmDialog, Popover, Select, Drawer, Tooltip) and FEAT-004 (container, selection prop, placeholder to replace). Independent of FEAT-006 except that the 'Open on device' / 'Send to device' menu and details actions are added in FEAT-006. Review findings addressed here: carried-over Wi-Fi password redaction in cards/rows/details with Reveal toggle, details-sidebar rule (closing details must not clear unrelated multi-selection), overlay primitives replacing absolute card menus and window.confirm, search/sort/filter/windowing for thousands of records, folders and tags rules (no QR deleted by folder delete, no duplicate tags).
steps: Read context.json, design.md 5.1-5.7 and 9; read the v1 card/menu/list code you are replacing in git history (`git show HEAD:src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx` on main, relevant sections: filteredRecords, card markup, relativeDate, typeBadgeClass, favorite toggle) to preserve working behaviour (thumbnail, type badge, updated time, favorite, Download PNG, Copy).

src/components/qr-studio/useWindowedList.ts: fixed row heights (list 56px, grid card 232px), column count from container width via ResizeObserver, visible range from the panel scroll container's scrollTop with 3 rows overscan, spacer for the remainder; exported FALLBACK_VIEWPORT_HEIGHT = 800 and FALLBACK_CONTAINER_WIDTH = 1000 used when measured size is 0, overridable by props initialViewportHeight/initialContainerWidth; returns visible range {firstIndex,lastIndex} for the status line. Pagination is replaced by this windowing (no 'Load more'). Tests: range math, overscan, grid columns, 5,000 records render only ~30-60 card nodes and only visible records request thumbnails.

src/components/qr-studio/useLibrarySelection.ts: selectedIds Set separate from detailsId (the record shown in the details panel). Checkbox per card/row, select-all-in-view acts on the full filtered result (not only rendered), shift-click range, Escape clears, selection pruned when records leave the filtered view. Rule: closing the details sidebar/drawer or changing detailsId must NOT clear selectedIds; the selected card is highlighted separately from checkbox-selected cards. Hoist selection to the container so TemplatesPanel's 'Apply to selected library records' gets the real set (replace the empty-set wiring from FEAT-004) and wire the bulk restyle to getRecordSvg-free restyle (update style, drop/regenerate svg only through the service).

LibraryPanel.tsx (replace the placeholder, remove its data-testid=qr-placeholder): layout folders rail (220px; becomes a FEAT-002 Select below 1100px container width), main list (toolbar: debounced 150 ms search over name+content+notes+tag names using the redacted wifi search key, type filter chips/select with live counts, sort Updated/Created/Name A-Z/Z-A/Type persisted with grid/list view in localStorage key `scrcpy-gui-plus:qr-studio:ui`, tag filter Popover with AND semantics, view toggle), details column 320px at >= 1280px container width else the FEAT-002 Drawer (modal). Status line at the bottom of the list: `Showing {firstIndex+1}-{lastIndex+1} of {total} items` computed from the windowed visible range and the filtered total (assumption: matches the reference's 'Showing 1-12 of 142 items' without reintroducing Load more; it updates on scroll). Empty states for each view. No horizontal scroll: toolbar uses flex-wrap, list min-w-0.

Folders: system views All (excludes Trash), Uncategorized, Favorites, Recent, Trash; custom flat folders with create/rename via Dialog (rules from the reducer; inline error in the Dialog, not notify), delete via ConfirmDialog 'N codes will be moved to Uncategorized. The codes are not deleted.' using the atomic reducer; Move via Menu/Select in card menu, bulk bar and details. Trash: Delete = soft delete; Trash view offers Restore, Delete forever (ConfirmDialog), Empty Trash (ConfirmDialog with count, danger tone, Cancel default focus). Tags: create-on-type input with case-insensitive dedupe selecting the existing tag, 'Manage tags' Dialog with rename/remove (confirm delete), assign multiple per record and in bulk (Add/Remove), filter.

Cards and rows (QrCard.tsx, QrRow.tsx): checkbox, thumbnail (img data URI from getRecordSvg with the LRU, only for visible items, inline error state on generation failure), name, type badge, folder + tag chips, updated time, favorite star, quick actions Download PNG and Copy, '...' FEAT-002 Menu (Preview, Edit, Duplicate, Move to..., Download SVG, Delete/Restore) rendered through the portal so it is never clipped and flips near the viewport bottom. Wi-Fi: cards/rows always show redactWifi(content). Bulk bar (sticky at top of the list when >= 1 selected): Move, Add/Remove tags, Favorite, Download (individual PNG downloads capped at 20 with a notice, otherwise disabled with tooltip 'Select 20 or fewer'), Delete to Trash (ConfirmDialog if > 5); in Trash: Restore, Delete forever. Edit in Create loads the record (with fields) into the draft, sets editingId, switches destination to Create; Duplicate copies source (reducer from FEAT-001).

Details panel (QrDetails.tsx): large preview, editable name (empty rejected -> revert, saves on blur), notes (<= 2000), folder Select, tag editor, content with Copy (Wi-Fi: password shown as ••••, a 'Reveal' toggle default hidden and reset on selection change; Copy copies the real content only after an explicit click), style summary, created/updated, actions Edit in Create, Duplicate, Download PNG/SVG, Trash (Open on Device and Send to Device are added in FEAT-006). Selection highlight on the active card.

Tests (Testing Library + user-event, generateQrSvg mocked): search by name, content and notes; wifi password not found by search and absent from details text until Reveal; type counts; sort (stable); grid/list toggle persisted; multi-select incl. shift-range and select-all-in-view; Escape clears; bulk move/tag/favorite/delete-to-trash; closing the details Drawer does NOT clear a multi-selection; folder create/rename/validation, delete folder keeps all QRs and moves them to Uncategorized; trash/restore/empty trash confirm default focus on Cancel; duplicate tag rejected/selects existing; Menu opens in a portal (the menu element is not a descendant of the card or the list scroll container), closes on Escape and returns focus; Delete uses ConfirmDialog (window.confirm spy not called); 5,000-record windowing test; status line text for first/mid/last window; edit-in-Create round trip; legacy-migrated record (no svg) renders a thumbnail through getRecordSvg; svgAccess.test.ts still passes.
Run verification; commit `feat(qr-studio): Library with folders, tags, trash, windowing and details`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/components/qr-studio src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx` passes with the new Library tests
No `data-testid="qr-placeholder"` remains for the Library destination
With 5,000 records the Library test shows only a small windowed subset of cards in the DOM and the status line reads `Showing a-b of 5000 items`
Closing the details panel does not clear a multi-selection; deleting a folder never deletes a QR record (tests)
Card menus render inside #qr-overlay-root, not inside the card (test), and `window.confirm` is never called
findings: Library destination done. Verified: npx vitest run src/components/qr-studio src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx (+ ui/services/navigation/app-shell) pass (371 tests scoped), npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm run build ok. FILES (src/components/qr-studio/): LibraryPanel.tsx (real, placeholder removed), QrCard.tsx, QrRow.tsx, QrDetails.tsx, RecordParts.tsx (RecordActions, RecordMenu, QuickActions, FavoriteButton, SelectCheckbox, Chip, iconButtonClass), FolderRail.tsx, LibraryDialogs.tsx (FolderDialog, MoveDialog, ManageTagsDialog), BulkBar.tsx, QrThumb.tsx, useWindowedList.ts (computeWindow/columnsFor pure, FALLBACK_VIEWPORT_HEIGHT=800, FALLBACK_CONTAINER_WIDTH=1000), useLibrarySelection.ts, libraryUtils.ts (QR_LIBRARY_UI_KEY, prefs, relativeDate, typeLabel, NO_FOLDER); tests LibraryPanel.test.tsx (31), useWindowedList.test.ts; QrStudioPage.test.tsx updated (placeholder assertion replaced, +2 Library tests). QrStudioPage.tsx only passes onStatus={setStatus} and containerWidth={width} to LibraryPanel. API: LibraryPanelProps adds optional onStatus, containerWidth (default 1280; rail collapses to Select <1100, details is a column >=1280 else modal Drawer), initialViewportHeight, initialListWidth (test hooks). The scroll container for windowing is the Library's own role=region aria-label='QR codes' div (not the tabpanel); grid 232px rows/4 cols at the 1000px fallback, list 56px rows, 3 rows overscan; status line text `Showing a-b of N items` uses the visible range without overscan. Selection is controlled by the container (selection/onSelectionChange) so Templates 'Apply to selected' already gets the real set (no further wiring needed; it restyles via store.saveEditedFromCreate). Closing/changing details never clears selection; selection is pruned to the filtered result while Library is mounted. Behaviour notes: single-record Delete moves to Trash without a confirm (reversible); confirm only for bulk trash > 5, Delete forever, Empty Trash (Cancel focused), folder delete, tag remove. Card/row menu: Preview, Edit, Duplicate, Move to… (opens MoveDialog with Select), Download SVG, Delete (Trash view: Preview, Restore, Delete forever). Duplicating selects the copy in details. Tag add input in details is role=combobox name 'Add tag' (datalist); bulk tags is a Popover labelled 'Tags', toolbar tag filter Popover labelled 'Filter by tags'. Card quick actions have aria-label 'Download PNG' / 'Copy' (copyQr: image when ClipboardItem exists else text; the text fallback copies Wi-Fi content as-is on explicit click). Details Copy content copies the real content. Name blur: empty reverts with 'Name cannot be empty'. FOR FEAT-006: add 'Open on device' / 'Send to device' to RecordMenu items in RecordParts.tsx (RecordActions interface) and the actions row in QrDetails.tsx; LibraryPanel builds the `actions` object (needs device props or an onOpenOnDevice callback from the container). Not done: visual/zoom verification (jsdom cannot prove clipping), Tooltip on every card quick action adds portal nodes only on hover. svgAccess.test.ts passes (QrThumb passes the whole record to getRecordSvg, no .svg property access).
